notes: Why K5: one legible Wrocław gesture — the rounded bridgehead corner (R 14 m, as on the 1934 plan) is the arched entrance portico below and the Sejmik panorama over the Odra and Ostrów Tumski above; both street frontages closed; leanest GFA (13,090 m²); best EP; all closed Sejmik rooms on the hall level (mezzanine only open gallery).

Weak points named by the jurors (to be fixed in the synthesis): Sejmik level overfilled (~70–130 m² short, no lobby corridor to committee rooms); presidium against a 33 × 10 m glass panorama; 6.6 m technical platform might count as a storey; horizontal band language weaker than vertical rhythm; SE segment 2.96 m from plot 10/2 (needs 3 m); PV double-counted on green roofs.

Grafts proposed by the jurors: vertical 'plot' rhythm and ceramic lamellas in front of the hall (K1); straight public axes bridge → hall → garden and Mazowiecka → boulevard (K3); the 'Garden of the Voivodeship' with zero-runoff retention, ramps to every row of the hall, garage + deliveries in one place from the boulevard (K4); trace of the 1934 frontage in the square paving (K1/K2).
Cost cross-check by jurors with the team model: all concepts 138–145 M PLN (mid prices + 5 % reserve); K5 ≈ 141.5 M — the most realistic margin.
Also ready for the montage: parametric façade generator (piers, bands, reveals, frames, cornices, fillets) tested in Blender.
